clips.title: The story
paras: Glyphic Memorandum is an introductory task directing novice mages in Coldridge Valley to their local trainer inside Anvilmar. Entrusted to mountaineer Sten Stoutarm, the missive summons budding arcane practitioners to seek out the eccentric gnome Marryk Nurribit to begin their formal spellcraft studies.

While assisting mountaineer Sten Stoutarm with early duties across Coldridge Valley, newly arrived mages find themselves summoned by local arcane authority. Sten receives a written memorandum addressed to the fledgling spellcaster and passes it along, advising them to take a moment to read its contents and head inside the warmth of Anvilmar to meet its author.

The author of the memorandum is Marryk Nurribit, a gnome mage trainer stationed inside Anvilmar. Rather than drowning his pupil in dense theoretical lectures, Marryk offers straightforward, grounded advice: stay out of serious trouble, save coin for training and tavern drinks, and strictly avoid the radioactive disaster that is fallen Gnomeregan. With basic expectations set, Marryk stands ready to tutor newcomers in the arcane arts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marryk. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yeah, what's that, traveler? Speak up, if you don't mind. I don't hear so good after a few ales.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, yeah! Arcane Arts... Of course.

Here's what you need to know, friend: Don't get into too much trouble. Save some coin to buy me an ale... Or any spells ya might want. And stay the heck away from Gnomeregan. Other than that, have a good day! I'll be here if you need me or want to train... Or whatever.
